# Tumblr
> Tumblr is a social platform for discovering, creating, and sharing posts, fandom content, and community conversations.

Tumblr combines microblogging, social discovery, and community participation through blogs, tags, trending topics, and interest-based communities across web and mobile apps.

## Discover
- [Trending](https://www.tumblr.com/explore/trending): Browse trending topics, fandoms, memes, and conversations popular on Tumblr.
- [Explore](https://www.tumblr.com/explore/trending): Discover notable tags, posts, and current interests across the platform.
- [Communities](https://www.tumblr.com/communities/browse): Find and browse interest-based communities organized around shared topics and fandoms.

## Platform
- [About Tumblr](https://www.tumblr.com/about): Overview of Tumblr, its mission, and how the platform supports creative expression.
- [Apps](https://www.tumblr.com/apps): Download Tumblr apps and extensions for mobile devices and supported browsers.
- [Help Center](https://www.tumblr.com/help): Access support resources, product guidance, and troubleshooting information for Tumblr users.

## Account & Support
- [Help Center Home](https://help.tumblr.com/): Main support portal for account, posting, messaging, and settings help.
- [Tumblr Basics](https://help.tumblr.com/hc/en-us): Entry point for common support topics and getting started resources.
- [Submit a Request](https://help.tumblr.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact Tumblr support for account, technical, and policy-related issues.

## Policies
- [Terms of Service](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/terms-of-service): Rules governing use of Tumblr, user conduct, and platform responsibilities.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/privacy): Details how Tumblr collects, uses, and protects personal information.
- [Community Guidelines](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/community): Standards for acceptable content, safety, and behavior on Tumblr.
- [Copyright Policy](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/copyright): Explains copyright reporting, takedown procedures, and intellectual property expectations.

## Safety & Moderation
- [Report Abuse](https://help.tumblr.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Submit reports related to harassment, impersonation, or policy violations.
- [Privacy Choices](https://help.tumblr.com/hc/en-us): Find support information related to privacy controls and account settings.
- [Legal Policies](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/terms-of-service): Review legal terms and policies relevant to moderation and platform use.

## Mobile & Apps
- [Tumblr Apps](https://www.tumblr.com/apps): Official downloads for Tumblr on iOS, Android, and supported browser platforms.
- [iOS App](https://www.tumblr.com/apps): Access Tumblr for iPhone and iPad through the apps page.
- [Android App](https://www.tumblr.com/apps): Access Tumblr for Android devices through the apps page.

## Community Features
- [Browse Communities](https://www.tumblr.com/communities/browse): Explore communities centered on shared interests, creators, and fandoms.
- [Trending Topics](https://www.tumblr.com/explore/trending): Follow active discussions and popular tags across Tumblr.
- [About Tumblr](https://www.tumblr.com/about): Learn how Tumblr supports communities, creators, and participatory culture.

## Company & Legal
- [About](https://www.tumblr.com/about): Company and platform overview for Tumblr.
- [Help](https://www.tumblr.com/help): Official support and assistance resources.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/terms-of-service): Legal agreement for using Tumblr services.
- [Privacy](https://www.tumblr.com/policy/privacy): Privacy practices and data handling information.
